Question B-006-006-003.

Why the correct answer is right: An EFHW feed point has high impedance, so a transformer is commonly used to match it to 50-ohm coax.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "A transformer": Correct. An EFHW feed point has high impedance, so a transformer is commonly used to match it to 50-ohm coax.
- sourceIndex 1: "A quarter-wave stub": Those may be used in antenna systems, but a high-to-low impedance match for coax calls for a transformer here.
- sourceIndex 2: "A counterpoise": That item can be part of an RF return or grounding system, but it is not the feedline between radio and antenna.
- sourceIndex 3: "A good ground on the coax shield": Those may be used in antenna systems, but a high-to-low impedance match for coax calls for a transformer here.
